lines.en: Sssss, wings glide through the sky.
Grrrr, hungry dragon.
Flap flap flap, dragon flapping wings.
Tweet tweet tweet, hunting time.
Sssss, soaring high.
Rumble rumble, seeking prey.

lines.zh: 啾啾啾，天空中的掠食者。
lines.en: Tweet tweet, aerial predator.
Sssss, territory patrol.
Grrrr, searching for cooked chicken.
Tweet tweet, surveying surroundings.

lines.zh: 轻得像片叶子滑过气流。
lines.en: Light as a leaf, I slide through the air.

lines.zh: 绕着领地边缘低飞一圈。
lines.en: I skim the border of my territory.
Silently, waiting.
Rumble rumble, stay silent.
Sssss, in slumber.
Tweet tweet, patient.
Grrrr, protecting territory.
Sssss, waiting.
Rumble rumble, resting.
Tweet tweet, staying hidden.
Grrrr, stealthy.
Sssss, silent.
Wings folded, I doze at the cave mouth.
I tuck my snout into my wing.

lines.zh: 晒太阳，鳞片慢慢暖起来。
lines.en: I sun myself until my scales warm.
Tail hanging, I stay perfectly still.
Tweet tweet, spotting prey.
Rumble rumble, locking target.
Sssss, vigilant gaze.
Tweet tweet, approaching player.
Grrrr, noticing player.
Sssss, peering at player.
Tweet tweet, player nearby.

lines.zh: 我在树杈上找那个熟鸡肉的味道。
lines.en: Up in the fork I hunt the smell of roast chicken.
Sssss, locking on player.
Tweet tweet, ready to attack.
I heard your footsteps before I saw you.
Head tilted, I file you away.

lines.zh: 我身上的鳞甲被打歪了。
lines.en: The scales on my flank are knocked askew.

lines.zh: 有人在背后拍了我一下，很重。
lines.en: Something slapped my back, and it was heavy.

lines.zh: 熟鸡肉的味道，让我安静。
lines.en: The smell of cooked chicken calms me.
I fell in the grass and cannot climb out.

lines.zh: 我的翅膜破了，飞不起来。
lines.en: My wing membrane is torn. I cannot fly.
Please help!
Come and help me!
Save my companion!

lines.zh: 半只烤鸡就能让我缓过来。
lines.en: Half a roast chicken would set me right.

lines.zh: 翅膀尖缺了一小块，我歪着飞。
lines.en: A notch is torn from my wingtip and I fly crooked.

lines.zh: 低语着熟鸡肉的香味，你接近它。
lines.en: Whispers of cooked chicken lure you closer.

lines.zh: 它张开翅膀，准备迎接你的到来。
lines.en: It spreads its wings, ready to greet you.

lines.zh: 你小心翼翼地靠近它的巢穴。
lines.en: You cautiously approach its nest.

lines.zh: 它的眼神充满了对食物的渴望。
lines.en: Its eyes glow with desire for food.

lines.zh: 靠近它的瞬间，它却突然飞起。
lines.en: Just as you approach, it suddenly takes flight.

lines.zh: 你投掷熟鸡肉，希望能赢得它的信任。
lines.en: You toss cooked chicken, hoping to gain its trust.

lines.zh: 它在空中盘旋，观察你的一举一动。
lines.en: It circles in the air, watching your every move.

lines.zh: 你发现它的巢穴藏在巨大的岩洞里。
lines.en: You find its nest hidden in a massive cave.
It begins to approach you curiously.

lines.zh: 熟鸡肉在它嘴中轻轻咀嚼。
lines.en: It gently chews the cooked chicken in its mouth.
You collide with it mid-air.

lines.zh: 它的鳞片在你身上划出痕迹。
lines.en: Its scales scratch your skin.

lines.zh: 你被它的巨翅击中，飞得更高。
lines.en: Its giant wings hit you, sending you soaring higher.

lines.zh: 你迅速躲开它的锋利爪子。
lines.en: You quickly dodge its sharp claws.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴扫过你，你失去平衡。
lines.en: Its tail swipes at you, unbalancing you.

lines.zh: 你被它的火焰吐息灼伤。
lines.en: You are singed by its flame breath.

lines.zh: 它的翼膜轻触你的脸庞。
lines.en: Its wing membranes touch your face lightly.
You try to grasp its wings.
It pecks at your arm with its beak.
You grab its neck ring tightly.

lines.zh: 它们绕着彼此飞翔，展示爱意。
lines.en: They circle each other, showing affection.
The male发出欢快的叫声.

lines.zh: 雌性在空中翻滚，回应求偶。
lines.en: The female rolls in the air, responding to the courtship.

lines.zh: 它们开始在天空中舞蹈。
lines.en: They begin to dance in the sky.
They butt heads together.

lines.zh: 它们围绕巢穴盘旋，求偶。
lines.en: They circle the nest, seeking to mate.

lines.zh: 它们轻柔地触碰彼此的鳞片。
lines.en: They gently touch each other’s scales.
The male surrounds the female with its wings.
The female nods, accepting the courtship.

lines.zh: 它们相视而笑，亲密无间。
lines.en: They smile at each other, close and intimate.
Shakes wings, glances at you.

lines.zh: 张开小巧利齿，低声嘶叫。
lines.en: Opens small sharp teeth, growls softly.
Stretches wings, lands slowly.
Hums low, questioning.
Stares at you, wings trembling.
Hisses, wings vibrating.
Nods head, thinking.
Grunts, approaches you.
Grumbles, wings fluttering.
Growls low, showing authority.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，几乎擦着地面。
lines.en: I flatten myself almost against the ground.
Wings vibrate, focusing attention.

lines.zh: 快速掠过天空，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Skims sky, hunting prey.
Spreads wings, soaring.
Flies low, searching ground targets.
Dives, locking on prey.
Folds wings, dives down.
Closes wings, readying attack.
Stares ground, seeking weakness.
Wings vibrate, locking target.
Wings pressed down, I have chosen you.

lines.zh: 地面的动静被我捕捉到。
lines.en: The movement below has reached my senses.
There is a stranger's scent in the wind.

lines.zh: 我从高空开始盘旋下降。
lines.en: I begin to spiral down from high above.

lines.zh: 我一张嘴，火球就聚在喉咙。
lines.en: My mouth opens and a ball of fire gathers in my throat.

lines.zh: 双翼每秒抖十几下，我悬停着。
lines.en: My wings beat a dozen times a second as I hover.
Eyes focused, locking on prey.
Aiming at you, wings twitching.
The smell of cooked chicken. I know it.

lines.zh: 我算好了风，只等一个缺口。
lines.en: I have the wind worked out; I wait for a gap.
Aiming at you, wings slightly open.
Aiming at you, wings vibrating.
I circle you, lower each pass.
I work out the angle of my dive.
Eyes fixed, wings folding first.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲反光暴露了你。
lines.en: Your armor's glint gives you away.

lines.zh: 我记得你刚才躲的方向。
lines.en: I remember which way you dodged.
One more circle, then I strike.
I am already level with the treetops.
Butts you with its horn roaringly
Scratches at your armor with sharp claws
Growls lowly, trying to intimidate you
Bites at you, trying to drag you away

lines.zh: 用尾巴扫荡地面，寻找弱点
lines.en: Whips its tail across the ground, searching for weaknesses

lines.zh: 挥动翅膀制造气流，试图将你卷走
lines.en: Wings create an air current, trying to sweep you away

lines.zh: 快速扑向你，用爪子抓你
lines.en: Leaps at you, claws extended
Whips its tail at your legs
Bites at you with sharp teeth
Butts you with its horn, roaring
I dive, claws arriving first!
My jaws clamp your shoulder!
My tail whips your back!
The wind from my wings knocks you down!
Emerges from its nest
Patrols its territory in the sky
Appears at sunset
Scans for food from a high perch
Issues a warning call from afar

lines.zh: 在天空中发出尖锐叫声
lines.en: Releases a sharp cry from the sky
Flies slowly in the sky
Hatches from its nest
Patrols its territory at sunset
Scours the sky for prey

lines.zh: 晨光里，一只轻龙落下来。
lines.en: In the dawn light, a light dragon lands.
It flies over from the cliffs.

lines.zh: 白天的天空多了一个小影子。
lines.en: A small shadow joins the daytime sky.

lines.zh: 山洞口的岩壁上传来扑翼声。
lines.en: Wingbeats come off the cave-mouth rock.

lines.zh: 它绕着新领地飞第一圈。
lines.en: It flies the first circle of a new territory.

lines.zh: 风把它带到这片林子上空。
lines.en: The wind carries it over these woods.

lines.zh: 火对我没用，可这热度真烫。
lines.en: Fire cannot hurt me, but the heat still stings.

lines.zh: 一口气没提住，撞在树梢上。
lines.en: I lost my lift and hit the treetops.
Wings soaked. I can't stay up.

lines.zh: 轰的一声，我被掀进灌木。
lines.en: A bang threw me into the bushes.

lines.zh: 我这么轻，一支箭就够了。
lines.en: I'm light enough that one arrow counts.
I was injured by magic!
Roast chicken — I chew it in my dreams.

lines.zh: 雷打在翅膜上，我直往下坠。
lines.en: Lightning hits my wing membrane and I drop.

lines.zh: 我在虚空深渊中迷失了！
lines.en: I'm lost in the Void!
